blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm khaas taur par in halaat mein faidemand hai:

items: Problem space (tamam mumkin hal ka group) chhota ho, to tamam mumkin hal bana kar test karna mumkin ho.
Hal dhoondne ki koi saaf strategy (plan) na ho, aur exhaustive search (har option ko check karna) zaroori ho.
Heuristics ya rules se banaye jane wale hal ki ginti kam ki ja sake, jis se process zyada efficient ho jaye.

blocks.prompt: 3 digits wala lock code 000 se 999 tak aazma kar khul sakta hai. Generate and Test is masle ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Problem space chhota hai (1000 mumkin codes) aur har code jaanchna aasan hai, is liye sab aazmana mumkin hai; koi heuristic, jaise pehle zyada chance wale codes aazmana, ise tez kar sakta hai. Yeh misal samjhane ke liye hai, kitab se nahi.

blocks.text: Yeh program upar wale lock ki misal chalata hai: 000 se 999 tak har code generate karta hai aur test karta hai ke lock khula ya nahi. secret_code badal kar Run karein aur dekhein kitne codes aazmane pare.

secret_code = 427   # the lock opens only with this code (0 to 999)

def open_lock():
    for guess in range(1000):          # generate: 000, 001, 002, ...
        if guess == secret_code:       # test: does the lock open?
            return guess
    return -1

code = open_lock()
if code == -1:
    print("No code from 000 to 999 opened the lock.")
else:
    print("Lock opened with code", str(code).zfill(3))
    print("Codes tried:", code + 1)

items: Generate and Test tab istemal karein jab problem space chhota ho, koi behtar strategy na ho, ya heuristics hal ki ginti kam kar sakein.
